what: p01_comparators: paper 01 comparators (simpler routes) on the frozen R5 end-to-end inputs, sealed 2026-11-12 before any comparator run on a pilot or test head (user go 2026-11-12, 'do all').
setting: head-model commit b13c351: scripts/p01_comparators.py. C1 = charm (SimNIBS 4.6, installed charm.ini with threads = 4, --forceqform --forcerun) on the ax5 input; C2 = SynthSR commit 9e63935 (vendored ct-headmodel/vendor/SynthSR, Apache-2.0, SynthSR_v10_210712.h5, CPU, 4 threads) on the ax5 input, then C1's charm on its output; C3 = R5's own navprep output for the arm (labels, T1, skin) with its MNI maps replaced by an ANTs SyN registration (antspyx 0.5.3, antsRegistrationSyN[s], random_seed 0, fixed = SimNIBS MNI152_T1_1mm, moving = R5's T1) written on R5's map grids (coordinate images padded 100 voxels), arms 1mm and ax5. CPU only: E-cores 8-23, at most 6 jobs at a time, resource_guard, nice 10, 6 h limit per job. Inputs: runs/r5/e2e/{pilot,test}/inputs/ax5/*/0_ax.nii.gz (simulated before R5 was scored), sha256 list runs/p01_comparators/inputs_sha256.txt (105 files, list digest 58db5fa82e350e11e7366512dbf5d088acb176e47ca47f3f9e4f029cb6167a8c); 1mm = each case's charm input T1.
metrics: As r5_e2e, same code (m1_mri_e2e.score): against charm on the original 1 mm T1; targets = 10 MNI targets through the route's own MNI2Conform (unprojected); the 13 rTMS EEG positions and 4 fiducials warped by the route's own maps and projected on the skin of the route's own labels (C1/C2: charm's label_prep of that run; C3: R5's). Per row: mean of case means and the worst point. Wall time per head.
sets: pilot = r5_e2e's pilot heads (first 5 sorted R5 warp validation heads): machinery only; test = the 100 IXI test heads of r5_ixi_split, once. OASIS-3 and the 57 patients are not used.
rule: Reported only; no adoption, no gate, nothing here changes R5 or any past decision. R5 is not re-run or re-scored (its rows are read from runs/r5/e2e). Order: pilot, then test once if every pilot job ran (failures in the pilot stop the chain for a fix, which is disclosed; the test runs only with unchanged settings). A test job that fails or exceeds 6 h is a failure for that head, reported with the failure count, never retried with other settings. Analysis per comparator, arm and row: paired per-head difference of case means vs R5 on the same arm and heads (mean, 95 % bootstrap CI of 10,000 resamples with seed 0, Wilcoxon signed-rank p), worst points, failures, time. Allowed wording: 'R5 was more / less accurate than Ck by d mm (95 % CI ...)' per row, on these simulated inputs.
no_folding: Not judged: the written-map Jacobian over the whole map grid is not a valid folding test for charm's own maps (IXI002: about 2.2 million voxels <= 0 in charm's MNI2Conform_nonl, outside the head), so jacobian_min is recorded for every route but not interpreted or reported as folding.
disclosure: R5's results on the pilot and test heads are known (r5_e2e). Before sealing: C3's map construction was smoke-tested on one IXI training head (IXI002-Guys-0828; targets 1.92 mm mean vs charm) and SynthSR on a simulated ax5 of the same training head; no pilot or test head was run by any comparator. The draft (docs/paper01_comparators_draft.md) changed in one point: C1/C2's EEG positions and fiducials are projected on their own label skin with r5_e2e's code instead of read from charm's eeg_positions csv, so every route is scored by the same code. GRACE (optional C4) is not run.
